verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, or equivalent machine-readable API spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. What Recruitee does offer is an llms.txt index and markdown versions of its documentation pages. These are machine-readable docs, not a structured API specification, so they count only as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown v
